purpose: Answer forms of the exercises releases that check_release_answers.py does not look for: words so generic that this repository uses them in its own text (spike/scripts/check_release_answers.py). By item ID and form, never the answer itself. Each is reviewed: the repository's use must not be about the practice set. Rule (owner, 2026-10-12): when a new exercises release fails the check only because of generic words the repository uses in its own text, the agent adds the exemptions itself, with reasons, without asking; it asks the owner only if a flagged line could be about the practice set itself. The check still never prints or stores an answer.
